businessGoal: Allow visitors to view detailed product information before making a purchase decision.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product detail page is displayed when a product is clicked from the overview or category page.
Verify that the product image, name, description, price, category badge, and brand badge are displayed on the product detail page.
Verify that the related products section is displayed below the main product information and that each related product is clickable and navigates to its detail page.
